technical_summary: Customer workload: mixed real-time chat + high-throughput reranking. Peak concurrency target 300 concurrent requests; steady-state concurrency ~120. Throughput objective: sustain ~2.5k tokens/sec per model with burst capacity to 10k tokens/sec. Latency SLOs: p95 < 200ms for 64-token prompts (with KV cache/hot path), p99 < 400ms. Requires reserved GPU pool planning (H100 pref), autoscaling with deterministic scale-up windows and controlled scale-down to avoid flapping.
autoscaling_requirements: Scale-up threshold: GPU util >= 65% for 45s OR request queue depth > 50 for 30s
Pre-warm policy: allocate warm pods ahead of predicted scheduled spikes (cron + autoregressive traffic predictor)
Scale-down policy: cooldown 10m after last scale-up; graceful drain window 60s to finish KV cache hits
Predictable cold-start: maintain a minimum warm-pool equal to 15-20% of reserved capacity
warm_pool_strategy: Customer prefers a dedicated warm pool for primary model variants: target warm-pool = 20% of reserved GPUs (min 2 GPUs). Warm pool must keep model weights resident and maintain warmed kernel JIT caches. Charge model: billable reserved capacity + optional warm-pool credit; customer wants clarity on billing when warm pool is active but underutilized.
queueing_and_backpressure: Require bounded queue with backpressure to callers. Reject policy for > 500 queued requests per model or route overflow to cheaper A10G pool for non-latency-critical reranking. Need SLAs for queue wait time (p95 < 300ms) and observable metrics: queue depth, oldest-request-age, reject-rate. Tracing hooks and per-request cost attribution required.
sla_and_sizing: Requested SLA: 99.9% uptime for Dedicated pool, latency SLOs as above with financial penalties in SOW appendix. Initial sizing proposal: reserve 8 x H100 (80GB) with autoscale buffer for a peak of 16 GPUs for burst windows. POC to validate kernel-level perf: run perf harness for 2 models (chat-small, reranker-medium) with synthetic and production traces.
